title: Treatise on the Banked Throw
summary: Teaches throws that bank off walls and corners to reach targets behind cover and return to hand.

title: A Practical Manual of the Thrown and Recovered Ring
summary: Pairs each throw with the stoop or scoop that recovers the spent ring so the thrower stays armed.

title: Handbook of Ring and Wrist
summary: Builds the wrist strength and fine control behind a full-circle release and the rim lock against blades.

title: Method of the Double Flight
summary: Teaches throwing two rings together at different heights and angles so one guard cannot answer both.

title: Canon of the Ricochet Throw
summary: Sets out glancing throws that carom off armor and blades to reach the gaps beside them.

title: Notes on the Fingertip Orbit
summary: Develops the ring spinning on a fingertip as both a guard against blades and a quick fling.

title: A Guide to the Edge-On Cast
summary: Shows how to throw the ring edge-on with qi-honed rims to cut straps and cloth and clear darts.

title: Drill-Book of the Moving Thrower
summary: Trains a thrower to release accurately while walking pivoting and running so the ring adds to body speed.
